paragraphs: The XK8 was Jaguar's V8 grand tourer, launched in 1996 and produced through to 2006. The XK8 specifically uses the 4.0-litre AJ-V8 family — the AJ26 from 1996 to 1999, and the AJ27 from 1999 to 2006 — both naturally aspirated petrol V8s. The AJ27 was an evolution of the AJ26, bringing improvements to the engine management and some internal components, but both engines share the same basic architecture and the same known wear pattern around the timing chain tensioners. The XK8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 4.0-litre V8 fitted to the XK8 from 1996 to 1999 (X100). Known for timing chain tensioner wear — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guides as standard on every AJ26 rebuild.

A 4.0-litre V8 fitted to the XK8 from 1999 to 2006 (X100). The later evolution of the AJ26, it shares the same known pattern around timing chain tensioner wear. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guides as standard on every AJ27 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The XK8's AJ26 and AJ27 engines are both 4.0-litre V8s, and they share most major dimensions and ancillaries, but there are differences in engine management and some internal components that mean the two are not fully interchangeable. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
